{{Quote|Vjun? Isn't that just a big, dead rock?|[[Kyle Katarn]]|audio=Vjun.flac|<ref name="Jedi Academy" />}}
'''Vjun''' (or '''Vijjun''') was a dark, almost lifeless [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Vjun system/Legends|Vjun system]], known for its [[Acid rain/Legends|acidic rainfalls]]. It was also renowned for its expensive hand-woven [[Vjun tunic|tunics]]. It was the location of [[Bast Castle]], a fortress used by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and later a place where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] studied the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

==History==
===Refuge for the Sith===
After the fall of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], Vjun was one of the refuges for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Atlas" />

Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], Viscountess [[Mireya]] of Vjun married into the [[Tapani Noble Houses|Tapani nobility]] by wedding [[High Lord]] [[Tritum XI]] of [[House Mecetti]]. Mireya brought with her Sith teachings that corrupted the House's protector organization, the [[Mecrosa Order]], turning it into a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]].<ref name="Evil Never Dies" />

Vjun was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[House Malreaux|Malreaux family]], one of the oldest and wealthiest on the planet. The [[Malreaux|Viscount Malreaux]] performed experiments on [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] that drove the populace of Vjun insane, leading to their murder of each other in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. One of the few survivors was the Viscountess [[Whirry Malreaux]], who gave her son, [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]], to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] so he could escape the horrors of his birthworld. Whirry remained on Vjun with her [[Force familiar]], the [[Vjun fox]] [[Miss Vix]]. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] such as the [[FIII Footman droid]] and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] were used as the workhorses of the Vjun population as they were rather more resilient to the highly acidic climate.

===Clone Wars===
[[File:Dooku_Son_of_Dathomir.png|thumb|left|175px|Vjun was a hiding place for Count Dooku (pictured)]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Vjun was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="Atlas" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Château Malreaux]] served as a hideout for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After taking over the château, he invited [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|come]] and save him from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. In reality, Dooku had hoped to use the power of the dark side to destroy his former master. When Yoda arrived, he told Dooku to try and convert him to the dark side. Although Dooku told him of the wonders of the dark side, Yoda could not be turned and so Yoda tried to convert Dooku back to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]]. This failed when Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] appeared and Dooku suspected treachery.

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|Ooookay, so it's a big, dead, important rock.|[[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="Jedi Academy" />}}
[[File:Bast_Castle.jpg|thumb|right|[[Bast Castle]] on the dreary surface of Vjun]]
The planet later served as the headquarters of dark-side Executor [[Sedriss QL]] and Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Side Elite|elite forces]] of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Before this, it was where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal fortress, [[Bast Castle]], resided. It had concentrated acid rain and the fortress was well guarded by many of Vader's best troops, including the legendary [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]].

During the later phases of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]-turned [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[X2]] led [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces to Bast Castle in the [[Battle of Vjun]] in order to find his brother, [[X1]], now a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. [[Kam Solusar]] trained as a [[Dark Side Elite]] on Vjun before [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] turned him to the light-side on [[Nespis VIII]], six years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Soon after, three [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] prisoners from [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] were taken to Vjun to serve as raw material for creating new clone bodies of Emperor Palpatine. The Ysanna were frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] to await the future construction of a clone laboratory within Bast Castle. However, Luke Skywalker and his Jedi trainees [[Mission to Vjun (Operation Shadow Hand)|stormed the castle]] to defeat the Emperor's minions.

[[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jaden Korr]] [[Mission to Vjun (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|visited]] Bast Castle in order to stop the cult known as the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] from draining the Force energy there. They soon found that Kyle Katarn's missing pupil, [[Rosh Penin]], had been turned to the dark side and was stealing the energy himself. After a battle with Jaden Korr, [[Desann]]'s former apprentice, [[Tavion Axmis]], eventually came forth as the leader of the Disciples of Ragnos. However, she escaped with Rosh.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

===Post-Imperial period===
Later, in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], the Jedi historian [[Tionne Solusar]] discovered that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] had been recovered by Vader and stored at Bast Castle. Since an information broker had sold this information to them, she feared that others may have gotten to it first. Thinking it was just a simple trip and time for training, Tionne allowed [[Anakin Solo]], [[Tahiri Veila]], [[Uldir Lochett]], and [[Ikrit]] to accompany her. They left on her [[Jemlaat-class in-system sail yacht|''Jemlaat''-class yacht]] ''[[Lore Seeker]]''.

Having arrived at Bast Castle, they discovered another vessel and feared another group had reached it first. Tionne also discovered [[hssiss]] on Vjun, just like those on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], suggesting the creatures had been bred on both worlds by the ancient Sith. Having survived the fortress's automated defense systems and booby traps, they discovered the lightsaber in a protected alcove. Unfortunately, a group of mercenaries and pirates under a cloaked man named [[Orloc]] arrived. Orloc wielded a lightsaber and claimed to be a mage who possessed great powers. His henchmen also stole Kenobi's lightsaber.

In response, the Jedi pursued Orloc and his henchmen on a chase through Bast Castle. During a confrontation, Orloc easily defeated Ikrit in lightsaber combat since the [[Kushiban]] had no lightsaber at all. He also deceived Uldir by claiming to train him in all the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|skills]] he desired. However, the other Jedi managed to rescue Uldir and escape Bast Castle, along with Kenobi's lightsaber and the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] of the ancient Jedi Master [[Asli Krimsan]].

The planet would come under the control of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vjun is mistakenly referred to as '''Djun''' in ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''. Early press releases for ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' also used the name Djun.

Vjun is pronounced as "VAH-JUHN" in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', but in ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', it is pronounced as "VUHN".

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Vjun in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]].
